live.f2_rule: direction*(close - closed_h4_ema(raw,200)) >= 10*atr on completed M15 signal bar, else reject macro_distance_too_small

f2ml2.f2_rule: direction*(close - closed_h4_ema(raw,200)) >= 10*atr on completed M15 signal bar, else reject macro_distance_too_small

tp20.f2_rule: direction*(close - closed_h4_ema(raw,200)) >= 10*atr on completed M15 signal bar, else reject macro_distance_too_small

shared_rules: 26b8 native rules from NATIVE_CELL: SELL 48-bar breakdown below H4 EMA, SL 2.5ATR, TP 1.35R, BE 1R; BUY RSI7>30 above rising EMA50, TP 3R; cooldown 2 bars; daily stop 10%; fixed 0.01; 10% cost-inclusive cap; loss day = UTC day

window.seen_until: 2026-11-24T08:00Z (F2/F3 research data end); local input ends 2026-11-16
window.input: runs/c22-forward-shadow-2026-11/input (monthly build; integrity per that protocol, re-hashed at run)

account.mode: one continuous book per (balance, view, profile) from window start; no reset; no funding
account.note: b400 = research basis of docs/research/2026-11-24 and approx live balance; live balance not read from VM at freeze

maturity.rule: verdict only when (end-start)>=90d AND live has >=60 trades AND >=40 SELL trades in b400|base; else INTERIM
maturity.power_note: at ~13 trades/month a 1-2 month window cannot separate TP 1.35R from 2.0R; INTERIM reports are descriptive only

verdict.rule: per arm vs live: NOT_EXERCISED if ledger identical in b400 base AND stress; FORWARD_CONSISTENT iff in both views arm net >= live net AND arm maxDD <= live maxDD; else FORWARD_INCONSISTENT. b300 reported, not decisive.
verdict.decision_use: CONSISTENT is evidence for the owner to consider a new release; it never changes the bot by itself. INCONSISTENT -> keep live.
verdict.rollback_watch: each run reports live vs native (net, maxDD, worst month) per README 2026-11-24 item 7; informational, owner decides

causality: each run, b400 base+stress: prefix runs of all profiles at Sat 00:00 and Wed 12:00 cutoffs (ticks truncated, bars/indicators/EMA re-prepared before cutoff) must reproduce admission events before cutoff; any mismatch, or zero cutoffs once mature -> INVALID

parity.f2_distance: 2026-11-24 check: F2 distance on this input vs live-crosscheck.csv for 9 live trades differs by 0.04-0.19 ATR; skip decision equal on all 9 (4.70 and 8.45 skipped, rest >= 15.8). Borderline signals within ~0.2 ATR of 10 may differ from live.
parity.seen_run: reports/seen-* (2026-10-24..input end) is informational and seen; not used for any verdict
